subject: GEMO
title: Introduction to Modelling
description: Multi-disciplinary course, modeling challenge by team, epidemiology, climate science and aeronautics.

prerequisites.text: GEMA 111. GEMA 112. GEPH 111. GEPH 112. GECH 111. GECH 112. GEBI 111. GECS 111. GECS 112.

restrictions.text: Open only to Global Engineering Students.

notes: This course is equivalent to MOD111 offered by CentraleSupélec in France.
